examples.text: Je n’y aurais point d’objection sérieuse, car de tout temps, on s’est montré porté à enhucher les poupes, à surbaisser par contre les avans.
examples.translation: I wouldn’t have any serious objection to it, because throughout time, people have shown a tendency to hang the sterns, while lowering the bows in contrast.
examples.english: I wouldn’t have any serious objection to it, because throughout time, people have shown a tendency to hang the sterns, while lowering the bows in contrast.

examples.text: Il ne faut pas pour si peu s’enhucher le tempérament, tonnerre de Brest !
examples.translation: There’s no need to hook your temper for such a trivial matter, thunder of Brest!
examples.english: There’s no need to hook your temper for such a trivial matter, thunder of Brest!
